tweets.author: Brian McTaggart
tweets.html: It was a great night for the three players the Astros got from the Cubs in the Kyle Tucker trade:Hayden Wesneski gave up three runs in seven innings.Cam Smith went 3-for-4 with a homer and game-tying single in ninth.Isaac Paredes was 2-for-4 with a two-run double in 10th.

tweets.author: Brian McTaggart
tweets.html: Down to their last strike, the Astros rally for a run in 9th and push three across in the 10th to beat the Giants, 6-3, in a game they really needed to win.The Astros are 61-59 and remain in first place in the AL West.
